import re
p = 'JauneConsensus/Facts/WithdrawalOrder.lean'

CT = "((!((hasExecutionWithdrawalCredential v) && (v.withdrawal_credentials.toBytes.drop 12 == wr.source_address.toBytes)))) = true)"
CF = "¬((!((hasExecutionWithdrawalCredential v) && (v.withdrawal_credentials.toBytes.drop 12 == wr.source_address.toBytes)))) = true)"
AT = "(((!(isActiveValidator v cur))) = true)"
AF = "¬(((!(isActiveValidator v cur))) = true)"
EF = "¬((((v.exit_epoch != FAR_FUTURE_EPOCH))) = true)"
FF = "¬((((wr.amount == FULL_EXIT_REQUEST_AMOUNT))) = true)"
PF = "¬((((pb == U64.zero))) = true)"
GF = "¬((((hasCompoundingWithdrawalCredential v) && (decide (minAct ≤ v.effective_balance)) && (decide (sum < balance)))) = true)"
C2T = "(((!(hasCompoundingWithdrawalCredential v))) = true)"
C2F = "¬(((!(hasCompoundingWithdrawalCredential v))) = true)"
S2T = "(((!(decide (minAct ≤ v.effective_balance)))) = true)"
S2F = "¬(((!(decide (minAct ≤ v.effective_balance)))) = true)"

def rep(old, new, count=0):
    global src
    n = src.count(old)
    assert n > 0, f"NOT FOUND: {old[:70]!r}"
    if count: assert n == count, f"COUNT {n} != {count} for {old[:70]!r}"
    src = src.replace(old, new)

# global unambiguous Bool-if side proofs
rep("rw [if_neg (by simp [hempty])]",
    f"rw [ite_eq_right (show {QF} from by simp [hempty])]")
rep("rw [if_pos (by simp [hbad])]",
    f"rw [ite_eq_left (show {CT} from by simp [hbad])]")
rep("rw [if_neg (by simp [hgood])]",
    f"rw [ite_eq_right (show {CF} from by simp [hgood])]")
rep("rw [if_pos (by simp [hact])]",
    f"rw [ite_eq_left (show {AT} from by simp [hact])]")
rep("rw [if_neg (by simp [hact])]",
    f"rw [ite_eq_right (show {AF} from by simp [hact])]")
rep("rw [if_neg (by simp [hnoexit])]",
    f"rw [ite_eq_right (show {EF} from by simp [hnoexit])]")
rep("rw [if_neg (by simp [hnofull])]",
    f"rw [ite_eq_right (show {FF} from by simp [hnofull])]")
rep("rw [if_neg (by simp [hpb])]",
    f"rw [ite_eq_right (show {PF} from by simp [hpb])]")
rep("rw [if_neg (by simp [hcomp, hsuff])]",
    f"rw [ite_eq_right (show {GF} from by simp [hcomp, hsuff])]")
rep("rw [if_neg (by simp [hcomp, hsuff, hexc])]",
    f"rw [ite_eq_right (show {GF} from by simp [hcomp, hsuff, hexc])]")
rep("rw [if_pos (by simp [hcomp])]",
    f"rw [ite_eq_left (show {C2T} from by simp [hcomp])]")
rep("rw [if_pos (by simp [hsuff])]",
    f"rw [ite_eq_left (show {S2T} from by simp [hsuff])]")
rep("rw [if_neg (by simp [hsuff])]",
    f"rw [ite_eq_right (show {S2F} from by simp [hsuff])]")

# per-witness ambiguous line: notCompounding gate (G-false) vs insuf/noExcess inner1 (C2-false)
parts = src.split("/-- ")
for i, part in enumerate(parts):
    if part.startswith("The not-compounding reason"):
        assert part.count("rw [if_neg (by simp [hcomp])]") == 1
        parts[i] = part.replace("rw [if_neg (by simp [hcomp])]",
            f"rw [ite_eq_right (show {GF} from by simp [hcomp])]")
    if part.startswith("The insufficient-effective-balance reason") or \
       part.startswith("The no-excess reason"):
        assert part.count("rw [if_neg (by simp [hcomp])]") == 1, part[:60]
        parts[i] = part.replace("rw [if_neg (by simp [hcomp])]",
            f"rw [ite_eq_right (show {C2F} from by simp [hcomp])]")
src = "/-- ".join(parts)

# direct-hyp rws: rename only
rep("rw [if_pos hfull]", "rw [ite_eq_left hfull]")
rep("rw [if_pos hexit]", "rw [ite_eq_left hexit]")
rep("rw [if_pos hlt]", "rw [ite_eq_left hlt]")
rep("rw [if_neg hearly]", "rw [ite_eq_right hearly]")
rep("rw [if_neg hret]", "rw [ite_eq_right hret]")
rep("rw [if_pos hret]", "rw [ite_eq_left hret]")
rep("rw [if_neg hcond", "rw [ite_eq_right hcond")
rep("rw [if_pos rfl]", "rw [ite_eq_left rfl]")
rep("rw [if_pos he]", "rw [ite_eq_left he]")

# leftovers with direct hyps or bound proofs: global word-boundary rename
src = re.sub(r'\bif_pos\b', 'ite_eq_left', src)
src = re.sub(r'\bif_neg\b', 'ite_eq_right', src)
assert 'if_pos' not in src and 'if_neg' not in src, "leftover if_pos/if_neg"

print("ok")
